cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please endorse the new rota into this microphone. 'Fine' needs to go on the meeting record.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already told you it was fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Privately. That isn't an endorsement the staff can check. State which rota you're supporting, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Attach the rota and copy the whole staff. Please don't send me another endorsement only I can see.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 meeting record, A3 precise rota identification and A5 attachment and recipients make professional documentation serve public endorsement.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 prior private fine is compatible with A1 request to record it; B4 email offers another attributable medium.

relationship.evidence: B2 objects to repetition; B4 negotiates a practical alternative that A5 accepts with conditions.

heightening.evidence: B4 email offer causes A5 attachment and whole-staff distribution instructions.

specificity.evidence: A1 new rota and meeting record plus A3 staff establish who must see support and why.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 corrects medium and specificity; A5 gives necessary email details with one strained reminder.
